title: Wake on LAN via pfSense Actions
description: Sends Wake-on-LAN requests through pfSense Actions to power on remote PCs, waits for them to boot, and launches a remote desktop application of your choice. Supports multiple PCs with a management UI.

versions.notes: Works with pfSense Actions 2.0 access tokens, flags old 1.x API keys, and retries rate-limited requests.
Requests run in the background, so the script stays responsive while it waits.
Pauses after confirmations so dialogs no longer overlap.
First version. Wakes a remote PC through pfSense Actions.
